article.title: ‘We are not beggars’: UNRWA cuts off aid to six Palestinian refugee camps in northern Lebanon
article.author: Alaa Serhal
article.content: The United Nations Relief and Works Agency has excluded six Palestinian refugee camps in Lebanon from emergency cash assistance, as Israeli attacks and Western donor cuts leave families choosing between food and medicine.
